propositions.name: aether_exists_material_substance
propositions.statement: The aether is a material substance more subtle than visible bodies that exists in parts of space which are apparently empty.
propositions.quote: a material substance of a more subtle kind than visible bodies, supposed to exist in those parts of space which are apparently empty

propositions.name: newton_law_of_gravitation
propositions.statement: The heavenly bodies mutually gravitate according to Newton's law, giving a complete quantitative account of their motions.
propositions.quote: the mutual gravitation of the heavenly bodies, according to Newton's law, they had a complete quantitative account of their motions

propositions.name: luminiferous_aether_exists
propositions.statement: An aether invented to explain the propagation of light has survived as the medium of light.
propositions.quote: The only aether which has survived is that which was invented by Huygens to explain the propagation of light.

propositions.name: aether_properties_explain_electromagnetism
propositions.statement: The properties of the aether deduced from the phenomena of light have been found to be precisely those required to explain electromagnetic phenomena.
propositions.quote: the properties of this medium, as deduced from the phenomena of light, have been found to be precisely those required to explain electromagnetic phenomena

propositions.name: light_not_a_substance
propositions.statement: Light is not itself a substance.
propositions.quote: That light is not itself a substance may be proved from the phenomenon of interference.

propositions.name: interfering_beams_can_cancel
propositions.statement: Two portions of light, when combined, can destroy each other and darken a screen.
propositions.quote: but if both are allowed to pass, the screen in certain places becomes dark, and thus shows that the two portions of light have destroyed each other

propositions.name: light_is_process_not_substance
propositions.statement: Light is not a substance but a process going on in a substance.
propositions.quote: We therefore conclude that light is not a substance but a process going on in a substance

propositions.name: interference_depends_on_path_difference
propositions.statement: Light is extinguished when the difference of the length of the paths of two portions of light is an odd multiple of a half wave-length.
propositions.quote: we find that the light is extinguished when the difference of the length of the paths is an odd multiple of a certain small distance called a half wave-length

propositions.name: light_propagates_at_finite_velocity
propositions.statement: Light is propagated with a certain finite velocity in vacuum.
propositions.quote: light is known to be propagated with a certain velocity (3.004 x 10 centimetres per second in vacuum, according to Cornu)

propositions.name: light_process_periodic_expression
propositions.statement: The configuration of the process at a given instant is called a wave, the distance 2 pi over P is called the wave-length, and the velocity of propagation is n over p.
propositions.quote: The configuration at a given instant is called a wave , and the distance 2 π / P is called the wave-length . The velocity of propagation is n / p.

propositions.name: process_capable_of_reversal
propositions.statement: The process constituting light may be a displacement, a rotation, an electrical disturbance, or any physical quantity capable of assuming negative as well as positive values.
propositions.quote: It may be a displacement, or a rotation, or an electrical disturbance, or indeed any physical quantity which is capable of assuming negative as well as positive values.

propositions.name: interference_depends_on_polarization_planes
propositions.statement: When the planes of polarization of two rays are at right angles, no interference can be discovered.
propositions.quote: when the planes of polarization are at right angles, the illumination of the screen becomes uniform, and no trace of interference can be discovered

propositions.name: light_vibration_transverse
propositions.statement: The physical process involved in the propagation of light is a vector at right angles to the ray.
propositions.quote: the physical process involved in the propagation of light must not only be a directed quantity or vector capable of having its direction reversed, but this vector must be at right angles to the ray

propositions.name: electric_displacement_magnetic_disturbance_perpendicular
propositions.statement: The electric displacement and the magnetic disturbance are perpendicular to each other.
propositions.quote: in this case the electric displacement and the magnetic disturbance are perpendicular to each other

propositions.name: invisible_radiations_show_interference
propositions.statement: Radiations that do not affect the eyes but can be detected by heating or chemical effects also show the phenomena of interference and have measurable wave-lengths.
propositions.quote: the phenomena of interference have been observed, and the wave-lengths measured, in the case of radiations, which can be detected only by their heating or by their chemical effects

propositions.name: aether_transmits_energy
propositions.statement: The aether is capable of transmitting energy.
propositions.quote: In the first place, it is capable of transmitting energy.

propositions.name: energy_not_transmitted_instantaneously
propositions.statement: Energy of radiation is not transmitted instantaneously from the radiating body to the absorbing body but exists for a certain time in the medium.
propositions.quote: this energy is not transmitted instantaneously from the radiating body to the absorbing body, but exists for a certain time in the medium

propositions.name: aether_has_elasticity_and_density
propositions.statement: The aether possesses elasticity similar to that of a solid body and has a finite density.
propositions.quote: We must therefore regard the aether as possessing elasticity similar to that of a solid body, and also as having a finite density.

propositions.name: aether_density_exceeds_atmosphere
propositions.statement: In interplanetary space the density of the aether is very great compared with that of the attenuated atmosphere of interplanetary space.
propositions.quote: In the regions of interplanetary space the density of the aether is therefore very great compared with that of the attenuated atmosphere of interplanetary space

propositions.name: air_cannot_transmit_transverse_vibrations
propositions.statement: Air cannot transmit transverse vibrations, and the normal vibrations air does transmit travel about a million times slower than light.
propositions.quote: the air cannot transmit transverse vibrations, and the normal vibrations which the air does transmit travel about a million times slower than light

propositions.name: aether_distinct_interpenetrates_matter
propositions.statement: The medium through which light is propagated is distinct from the transparent medium known to us, though it interpenetrates transparent bodies and probably opaque bodies too.
propositions.quote: the medium through which light is propagated is something distinct from the transparent medium known to us, though it interpenetrates all transparent bodies and probably opaque bodies too

propositions.name: light_velocity_varies_by_medium
propositions.statement: The velocity of light is different in different transparent media.
propositions.quote: The velocity of light, however, is different in different transparent media

propositions.name: aether_motion_relative_to_bodies
propositions.statement: When dense bodies move through the ocean of aether, they may carry the aether they contain with them, or the aether may pass through them.
propositions.quote: whether, when these dense bodies are in motion through the great ocean of aether, they carry along with them the aether they contain, or whether the aether passes through them

propositions.name: earth_orbit_relative_to_aether
propositions.statement: The earth has a velocity in its orbit relative to the aether that would increase the time of transmission of light by a small definite amount.
propositions.quote: the increase of this time on account of a relative velocity of the aether equal to that of the earth in its orbit would be only about one hundred millionth part of the whole time of transmission

propositions.name: fresnel_drag_hypothesis
propositions.statement: According to Fresnel's hypothesis, the relative velocity of the aether within a prism to that of the aether outside is inversely as the square of the index of refraction.
propositions.quote: according to Fresnel's hypothesis the relative velocity of the aether within the prism would be to that of the aether outside inversely as the square of the index of refraction

propositions.name: fizeau_water_drag_effect
propositions.statement: The propagation of light in a stream of water takes place with greater velocity in the direction in which the water moves than in the opposite direction.
propositions.quote: the propagation of light in a stream of water takes place with greater velocity in the direction in which the water moves than in the opposite direction

propositions.name: no_action_at_distance_magnetism
propositions.statement: In the transmission of magnetic force there is an action external to the magnet, rather than the effects being merely attraction and repulsion at a distance.
propositions.quote: I am much more inclined to the notion that in the transmission of the force there is such an action, external to the magnet, than that the effects are merely attraction and repulsion at a distance

propositions.name: light_and_electromagnetic_medium_conjecture
propositions.statement: The same medium which is concerned in the propagation of light might also be the agent in electromagnetic phenomena.
propositions.quote: Faraday conjectured that, the same medium which is concerned in the propagation of light might also be the agent in electromagnetic phenomena.

propositions.name: electrostatic_energy_depends_on_medium
propositions.statement: Electrostatic energy depends on a property of the medium in virtue of which an electric displacement elicits an electromotive force in the opposite direction.
propositions.quote: the former depends on a property of the medium, in virtue of which an electric displacement elicits an electromotive force in the opposite direction

propositions.name: electrokinetic_energy_is_medium_motion
propositions.statement: Electrokinetic energy is simply the energy of the motion set up in the medium by electric currents and magnets.
propositions.quote: The electrokinetic energy, on the other hand, is simply the energy of the motion set up in the medium by electric currents and magnets

propositions.name: electromagnetic_velocity_equals_light_velocity
propositions.statement: If the velocity of propagation of an electromagnetic disturbance is equal to the velocity of light, the electromagnetic medium and the luminiferous medium, occupying the same space, are really identical.
propositions.quote: If this should be equal to the velocity of light, we would have strong reason to believe that the two media, occupying as they do the same space, are really identical.

propositions.name: dielectric_capacity_equals_refraction_squared
propositions.statement: In non-magnetic media the specific inductive capacity should be equal to the square of the index of refraction.
propositions.quote: in non-magnetic media the specific inductive capacity should be equal to the square of the index of refraction

propositions.name: aether_incompressible
propositions.statement: The aether is incompressible.
propositions.quote: The only way of accounting for the fact that the optical phenomena which would arise from these waves do not take place is to assume that the aether is incompressible.

propositions.name: aether_transmits_vibrations_without_dissipation
propositions.statement: The aether transmits transverse vibrations to very great distances without sensible loss of energy by dissipation.
propositions.quote: We know that the aether transmits transverse vibrations to very great distances without sensible loss of energy by dissipation.

propositions.name: aether_not_gas_like
propositions.statement: The constitution of the aether cannot be like that of a gas, in which the molecules are always in a state of irregular agitation.
propositions.quote: We cannot therefore suppose the constitution of the aether to be like that of a gas, in which the molecules are always in a state of irregular agitation

propositions.name: aether_probably_molecular
propositions.statement: The aether, if it is the medium of electromagnetic phenomena, is probably molecular.
propositions.quote: The ather, if it is the medium of electromagnetic phenomena, is probably molecular, at least in this sense.

propositions.name: magnetism_is_rotational_motion
propositions.statement: The magnetic influence on light depends on the direction of motion of moving particles and indicates a rotational motion in the medium when magnetized.
propositions.quote: the magnetic influence on light discovered by Faraday depends on the direction of motion of moving particles, and that it indicates a rotational motion in the medium when magnetized

propositions.name: medium_broken_into_molecular_vortices
propositions.statement: The medium must be broken up into a number of molecular vortices, each a rotation of very small portions of the medium about its own axis.
propositions.quote: it must be a rotation of very small portions of the medium each about its own axis, so that the medium must be broken up into a number of molecular vortices

propositions.name: vortices_persist_without_dissipation
propositions.statement: The molecular vortices do not require a continual expenditure of work to maintain their motion, and this motion does not necessarily involve dissipation of energy.
propositions.quote: the molecular vortices do not require a continual expenditure of work in order to maintain their motion, and that therefore this motion does not necessarily involve dissipation of energy

propositions.name: interplanetary_space_not_empty
propositions.statement: The interplanetary and interstellar spaces are not empty but are occupied by a material substance or body, the largest and probably the most uniform body of which we have any knowledge.
propositions.quote: there can be no doubt that the interplanetary and interstellar spaces are not empty, but are occupied by a material substance or body, which is certainly the largest, and probably the most uniform body of which we have any knowledge
